subject: general
question: Which article of Indian constitution is related with Protection of interests of minorities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**29.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 29** provides protection to the** interests of minorities** by ensuring that they have the right to conserve their** distinct language, script, and culture.**
 
• This article prohibits the denial of admission to any educational institution on the grounds of religion, race, cast
